name: Electron
explain: Dedicated small-satellite orbital launch vehicle powered by Rutherford electric-pump-fed engines, optimized for rapid responsive LEO/SSO deployments.
basis: Rocket Lab Electron Payload User Guide, approximate, game-balanced

name: Vega-C
explain: European light-medium solid-propellant launch vehicle delivering cost-effective direct insertion to sun-synchronous polar orbits.
basis: Arianespace Vega-C User's Manual, approximate, game-balanced

name: Falcon 9
explain: Reusable two-stage medium-lift launch vehicle powered by 9 Merlin 1D engines. Outstanding flight heritage and high mission cadence.
basis: SpaceX Falcon 9 Launch Vehicle Payload User's Guide, approximate, game-balanced

name: Atlas V 551
explain: Heavy-configuration launch vehicle with 5 solid rocket boosters and a Centaur upper stage. Proven precision insertion for high-value science missions.
basis: United Launch Alliance (ULA) Atlas V Launch Services User's Guide, approximate, game-balanced

name: Falcon Heavy
explain: Heavy-lift launch vehicle composed of three Falcon 9 engine cores generating over 5 million pounds of liftoff thrust for high delta-V deep space trajectories.
basis: SpaceX Falcon Heavy Payload User's Guide, approximate, game-balanced

name: Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1
explain: Super-heavy exploration class rocket engineered for direct high-mass injection to lunar transits and the outer solar system.
basis: NASA SLS Mission Planner's Guide, approximate, game-balanced
